## 9/12/2023
```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(50)
n <- 60
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2",main="(S^1)^2 Data", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = 1
# compare centroids to nearest points to centroids
landmarks <- get_center(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
landmarks_centroids <- get_centroids(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
plot(clusters[landmarks,],
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rep('black',n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2", main="Nearest neighbors of centroids, landmark size = 10%", pch = 16
)
plot(polySphereToAngles(landmarks_centroids,dims)-pi,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rep('black',n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2", main="Centroids of clusters, landmark size = 10%", pch = 16
)

```

print(res_s12_sizes)

```{r, fig.show = 'hide'}
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

set.seed(10)
n <- 60
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2",main="(S^1)^2 Data", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1
x <- clusters

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = .1
trials=20

res_avg_s12_n <- microbenchmark(run_MDS_py(x, landmark_size = landmark_size, dims=dims, angular=angular,plot=FALSE,gradient = TRUE), run_MDS_py(x, landmark_size = landmark_size, dims=dims, angular=angular,plot=FALSE,gradient = FALSE), times = trials)
print(res_avg_s12_n)

```
